title: Blow-up convergence extends from C¹ to continuous compactly supported test functions
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, μ and τ measures on ℝ^P, y ∈ ℝ^P, ρ₁ > 0 and C ≥ 0 with μ(B̄_ρ(y)) ≤ C ρ^n for 0 < ρ < ρ₁, and τ(B̄_R(0)) < ∞ for every R. Suppose r^{-n} ∫ g(r^{-1}(z − y)) dμ(z) → ∫ g dτ as r ↓ 0 for every C¹ compactly supported g : ℝ^P → ℝ. Then r^{-n} ∫ f(r^{-1}(z − y)) dμ(z) → ∫ f dτ as r ↓ 0 for every continuous compactly supported f : ℝ^P → ℝ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ τ : Measure (Euclid P)) (y : Euclid P) (ρ₁ C : ℝ), 0 < ρ₁ → 0 ≤ C → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < ρ₁ → μ (closedBall y ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * ρ ^ n)) → (∀ R : ℝ, τ (closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R) ≠ ∞) → (∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ z, g (r⁻¹ • (z - y)) ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∫ z, g z ∂τ))) → ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ z, f (r⁻¹ • (z - y)) ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∫ z, f z ∂τ))
